meetings.lede: Video calls for the team and the guests you let in. Muse can take the notes and turn what was agreed into tickets.
meetings.joinWithCode: Join with a code or link
meetings.badCode: That is not a meeting code: it looks like abc-defg-hij.
meetings.noneUpcoming: No live or upcoming meetings. Start one now, or schedule one.
meetings.inCallNow: {n, plural, one {# person in the call} other {# people in the call}}
meetings.nobodyYet: Nobody is in the call yet
meetings.actionItemsN: {n, plural, one {# action item} other {# action items}}
meetings.offTitle: Meetings are off on this server
meetings.offBody: The server’s administrator turns them on with a LiveKit server (AGNTS_LIVEKIT_URL).
meetings.remindersSub: Before a meeting you are invited to starts, on your phone and here.
meetings.settingsSub: Recordings, what is kept and for how long, and how many people one call takes.
meetings.allowRecording: Hosts may record calls as video
meetings.keepAudio: Keep the audio of notes after Muse has heard it
meetings.newSub: A call now, or one in the calendar with invitations.
meetings.title: Title
meetings.descriptionPlaceholder: What the meeting is for. Muse reads it when it writes the notes.
meetings.accessHelp_invited: Invitees join; other members and guests knock.
meetings.guestsHelp_knock: People without a membership wait until a host lets them in.
meetings.guestsHelp_open: Anyone with the link joins without waiting, until the call ends.
meetings.inviteHelp: Everyone gets an email with the calendar event; people outside the workspace get a personal link.
meetings.inviteHelpNow: Members are told in agnts; addresses get the link by email.
meetings.autoNotes: Take notes: Muse hears the call and writes the decisions and action items
meetings.notesUnavailable: Notes are not set up on this server.
meetings.cancelBody: Invitees get the cancellation in their calendar. A call in progress ends.
meetings.deleteBody: Its calls, recordings, transcripts and chat are deleted. Notes documents stay.
meetings.noCalls: The meeting has not been live yet.
meetings.noNotes: Notes were not taken in this call.
meetings.notesBusy_recording: Notes are being taken; Muse writes them when the call ends.
meetings.notesBusy_queued: Waiting for Muse to hear the call…
meetings.notesBusy_transcribing: Muse is listening to the call…
meetings.notesFailed: The notes could not be written: {reason}
meetings.notesAgain: Muse is writing the notes again
meetings.deleteRecordingBody: The video is deleted for everyone. The transcript and notes stay.
meetings.mixedNote: Everyone’s audio was heard together, so the transcript does not say who spoke.
meetings.devicesBlocked: The browser blocked the camera and microphone. Allow them in the address bar, then try again.
meetings.devicesFailed: The camera or microphone could not start. Another app may be using it.
meetings.lobbyNotes: agnts is taking notes of this call.
meetings.notStartedYet: You can join 15 minutes before it starts.
meetings.orGoogle: Or show who you are with Google
meetings.waitingBody: Someone in the call will let you in soon.
meetings.endedBody: Notes and recordings appear under Past calls when they are ready.
meetings.removedTitle: You were removed from the call
meetings.removedBody: A host removed you. You can’t rejoin this call.
meetings.refused_removed: You were removed from this call
meetings.refused_guests_off: This meeting is for the workspace’s members
meetings.recordBody: Everyone in the call sees that it is recorded, and people who join are told before they do.
meetings.quietGuests: Turn off guests’ chat and screen sharing
meetings.guestsSpeakAgain: Let guests chat and share again
meetings.openTitle: Let anyone with the link in?
meetings.openBody: Until this call ends, guests join without waiting.
meetings.endBody: Everyone is disconnected. Notes are written from what was recorded.
meetings.hands: {n, plural, one {# raised hand} other {# raised hands}}
meetings.inCall: {n, plural, one {# in the call} other {# in the call}}
meetings.removeBody: They are disconnected on every device and can’t come back to this call.
meetings.chatEmpty: No messages yet. Messages are kept with the call.
meetings.chatOff: The hosts turned guests’ chat off.
meetings.hasStarted: A meeting you’re invited to has started
meetings.leaveBody: You can join again with the same link while the call is on.
meetings.leaveBodyHost: The call goes on without you. To close it for everyone, choose “End the call for everyone” in Host controls.
meetings.stopRecordingBody: What was recorded so far is saved and appears on the call’s page.
meetings.stopNotesBody: Muse writes the notes from what it heard until now.
meetings.muteAllBody: Everyone except you is muted. They can unmute themselves.
meetings.lockBody: Nobody new can join or knock until you unlock it. People already admitted, and the hosts, can still come back.
meetings.admitAllTitle: {n, plural, one {Let # person in?} other {Let # people in?}}
meetings.admitAllBody: Everyone waiting joins the call now.
meetings.cohostBody: Co-hosts can let people in, mute and remove them, record the call and take notes.
meetings.writeAgainBody: Muse writes them again from the call and replaces the current notes, with any changes made to them.
meetings.uninviteBody: They are no longer invited and get no more reminders.
